update_deferral_note.statement: Batch 03 authors ZERO `update` candidates. All seven applied touch points the inventory marked update / update-or-no_op are recorded as no_op here.
update_deferral_note.engine_reason: proposeKnowledge() builds its related-concept catalog from this batch's candidates only (`const catalog = new Map(pilot.candidates.map(...))`), and proposalBody() throws `unknown related concept` for any id outside it. A proposal document is regenerated in full from its candidate, so an `update` on an applied concept can only carry related_concepts drawn from this batch. Every batch-03 update target's existing related_concepts lie outside batch 03 (for example java.memory.garbage-collection relates to java.memory.heap, java.oop.instance and java.oop.member-variable, none of which have chap01-04 evidence). Authoring the update would therefore preserve the approved source locators but silently delete approved graph edges from a live document.
update_deferral_note.decision: Preserving approved provenance was read strictly: an update that keeps every source locator but drops approved related-concept edges is not additive, so no update was authored. The additive chap01-04 evidence is deferred to the scheduled consolidation batch, which can carry the neighbouring concepts and keep every edge.
update_deferral_note.net_effect: No applied knowledge document is touched by batch 03. Every candidate is a new concept, so apply would create files only and could not regress an approved document.
